name: deepl
description: DeepL API: translate and rephrase text, translate documents, usage, languages and glossaries

nodes.title: Translate text
nodes.description: Translate up to 50 texts into one language; translations[i].text belongs to text[i], with detected_source_language

target_lang.description: Target language, e.g. EN-US, EN-GB, DE, ID, PT-BR (see list_languages with language_type target)

source_lang.description: Source language, e.g. EN, ID (detected when omitted; required with glossary_id)

context.description: Extra context that guides the translation but is not translated (not billed)

formality.description: Formal or informal tone (some languages); prefer_* falls back silently

preserve_formatting.description: Keep punctuation and casing as is

tag_handling.description: Translate XML or HTML and keep the markup

custom_instructions.description: Short instructions, e.g. 'Use British spelling' (quality_optimized model)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Rephrase text (DeepL Write)
nodes.description: Improve or restyle texts with DeepL Write (Pro plans); improvements[i].text belongs to text[i]

target_lang.description: Language of the result, e.g. EN-US, DE (default: the text's language)

writing_style.description: simple, business, academic, casual (prefer_* to fall back)

tone.description: enthusiastic, friendly, confident, diplomatic (prefer_* to fall back)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
